meta.title: Give Feedback on the awarding page
warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen
moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

steps.note: Open Master QCS for the prepared closed RFQ with bids.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case configuration.
Enter the awarding page where Give Feedback is available.
Confirm the awarding page exposes the Give Feedback control.

args.goal: On the awarding page, click Give Feedback, choose a rating, enter QA, send the feedback, and verify the thank-you confirmation; then reopen Give Feedback, leave the feedback empty, attempt to send it, and verify the refusal message 'Please share your feedback'.

steps.note: Perform and verify the feedback submission and empty-feedback validation in the buyer session.
Assert the empty feedback attempt is refused with the required message.
